name: service1

dependencies.name: service2
dependencies.description: Fetches the current catalog of scored records to compute the average.

description: Public API that computes and returns the average score of Service2's current catalog as a whole number, discarding any remainder. It logs how many records it handled per request and returns a structured 404 body for any path it does not serve. It has no knowledge of or opinion about which mode Service2 is in — the same computation runs whichever catalog it is handed. It does not store or manage records itself.
